metadata.description: Medicai's own skills for AI coding assistants. Build medical imaging, radiology and patient-sharing features on the Medicai cloud PACS, DICOM viewer, cases and documents API, with or without a Medicai account.

plugins.name: medicai
plugins.description: Build medical imaging features on Medicai, the cloud PACS and DICOM viewer platform: embed a radiology-grade viewer (works before you have an account), upload CT, MRI, X-ray and ultrasound studies, organize cases with reports, share with patients and doctors, react to webhooks. For developers, clinics and health-tech teams.
